answer_2.quote: We use the attack success rate (ASR) as the initial metric to evaluate the performance of either attack mode (human and algorithmic).

answer_4.quote: we ask an independent set of crowdworkers to annotate the collected data. Specifically, in a new data collection stage, participants read and judged each adversarial example on its sentiment and naturalness, both on a five-point Likert scale.
answer_4.guideline: participants read and judged each adversarial example on its sentiment and naturalness, both on a five-point Likert scale. Here, a rating of 1 would denote very negative sentiment (a very unnatural review), whereas a rating of 5 would indicate a very positive sentiment (a very natural review).
